_comment: Style guide ruleset for the adversarial-design pipeline. Mirrors the production `design_bible.website` shape consumed by `_normalize_brand_tokens` in message_generator_from_scratch_v0_1.py. Each of the four rule-list keys maps exactly to what the code generator LLM receives as 'Brand Rules (SUPREME — NON-NEGOTIABLE)'. Populate `raw_pdf_dump` with the full PDF text; then extract/distil each rule into the four lists below. This file is passed as `--style-guide` to run_pipeline.py (wire-up TBD) and injected into the code_generator and creativizer prompts alongside the blueprint.

_usage.how_it_flows: run_pipeline.py loads this file → its four lists are JSON-serialised and injected verbatim into the code_generator and creativizer system prompts as the 'Brand Rules' block (same slot as the production pipeline). Rules are SUPREME: they override all generic design instructions in the prompt.
_usage.rule_format: Each rule is a plain English declarative sentence. Be specific: name hex codes, px values, font names, percentages. The LLM interprets these literally — vague rules produce vague output.
how_to_populate_from_pdf: 1. Paste the full PDF text into `raw_pdf_dump` below.
2. Run the extraction script: python scripts/extract_style_rules.py examples/style_guide_ruleset.json
(script uses Claude to distil the PDF into the four lists; review and trim output.)
3. Alternatively, manually pull rules: read the PDF, write one declarative sentence per rule,
place it in the correct category, commit.

content_pattern_rules: TEMPLATE — replace with real rules extracted from the brand PDF.
Example format: 'Headlines carry the primary data claim first (e.g. \"2× greater improvement\") before the endpoint name; avoid throat-clearing openers like \"Introducing\".'
Example format: 'Body copy is terse and clinical: max 2 sentences per paragraph, 12–14px, 1.5 line-height; no patient-narrative or warm conversational tone.'
Example format: 'Every efficacy statistic is followed by a superscript citation referencing the trial name and endpoint (e.g. \"−3.1 pts¹\"); citations appear inline, never footnote-only.'
Example format: 'ISI and references render at exactly 10px, #333333, clearly delimited from preceding sections by a 1px #E5E7EB divider.'
Example format: 'Single CTA only per email; CTA copy is an action verb + specific next step (e.g. \"Request a rep visit\"), never generic \"Learn More\".'
Example format: 'REMS warnings render in a visually distinct amber/yellow panel (#FFF8E1 background, #FFD54F border) immediately inside the safety section — never buried in the ISI.'
color_scheme_rules: TEMPLATE — replace with real rules extracted from the brand PDF.
Example format: 'Primary brand violet #4B2D8F used for section headlines (H1, H2), CTA button background, data callout numerals, and accent borders; never use as body text color on white.'
Example format: 'Secondary accent: light violet tint #F5F1FC for data callout cell backgrounds and panel fills; use alongside white to create hierarchy without competing with headline violet.'
Example format: 'Border and divider color: #D8C9F0 (soft violet-grey) for callout cell borders and section dividers; never use black or dark grey borders.'
Example format: 'Body text: #222222 on white backgrounds; #FFFFFF on violet (#4B2D8F) backgrounds. Never use grey body text on violet — it fails accessibility contrast.'

Example format: 'REMS / warning panel: #FFF8E1 background, #FFD54F border, #7B5A00 text; this amber palette is reserved exclusively for the meningococcal REMS warning and must not be reused decoratively.'
Example format: 'CTA button: #4B2D8F background, #FFFFFF label text, 4px border-radius; hover state not applicable in email — do not add :hover rules.'
design_pattern_rules: TEMPLATE — replace with real rules extracted from the brand PDF.
Example format: 'Email max-width 600px, margin: 0 auto, single centered column; no multi-column layouts except the QMG responder row (two equal cells side-by-side).'
Example format: 'Data callout cells use display:table / display:table-cell for email-client compatibility; never CSS Grid or Flexbox in the email body.'

Example format: 'Primary efficacy section (MG-ADL) is the visual apex: largest numeral on the page (min 36px, bold 700), rendered in primary violet #4B2D8F against the lightest background; no other section may use a numeral this large.'
Example format: 'Secondary endpoint sections (QMG, PD) use the same callout pattern but at 22px numerals and #F5F1FC backgrounds — visually subordinate to the primary endpoint without being hidden.'

Example format: 'Pharmacodynamic / mechanistic section uses a left-border callout (4px solid #4B2D8F, #F5F1FC background) instead of a full-width table cell — signals supporting science, not a headline claim.'
Example format: 'Section spacing: 20px top/bottom padding per section, 1px solid #E5E7EB bottom border; no section-level drop shadows or box shadows.'
Example format: 'All images use [images_base64_N] placeholder tokens; no external URLs. Alt text is required on every .'
Example format: 'Inline CSS only — no <link> stylesheets, no external fonts via @import; safe web-safe fallback stacks required (e.g. Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif).'
other_rules: TEMPLATE — replace with real rules extracted from the brand PDF.

Example format: 'Drug name on first mention per section: ULTOMIRIS® (ravulizumab-cwvz); subsequent mentions within the same section: ULTOMIRIS (no ®). Never abbreviate to \"ravu\" or omit the brand name in headline positions.'
Example format: 'Indication statement must use the exact approved text for anti-AChR antibody-positive generalized myasthenia gravis in adults; do not paraphrase the indication.'
Example format: 'Meningococcal REMS warning is mandatory in the safety section; omitting it from any email touching the safety section is a compliance failure.'

Example format: 'All numerical efficacy claims (MG-ADL −3.1, QMG −2.8, 30% responder) must carry a trial name citation superscript; placebo comparator values must appear alongside drug-arm values — neither may be presented alone.'
Example format: 'Brand sign-off is always Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease; never AstraZeneca alone.'
Example format: 'P-values render as P<0.001 or P=0.005 (capital P, no space before the operator); do not write \"p-value\" or \"p <.001\".'
Example format: 'Every email must include a PI access line in the signature directing HCPs to the full Prescribing Information, including BOXED WARNING and Medication Guide.'
